## ⚠️ 정정 (11/9 패킷과 달라진 점)
- **일요일 릴레이 웨이브가 오늘 또 바뀜**: Men 17:50–18:20 · Mixed 18:50–19:40 · Women 20:10–20:20. (11/8 패킷의 17:50–18:30 / 19:00–19:50 / 20:20–20:30 사용 금지. 이미 게시했으면 정정.)
- 나머지 금·토 웨이브, 등록 시간, 주차 ₩3,720/h·₩19,000 all-day는 변동 없음.
- 시상식 시간표는 여전히 섞여 있음 → 쓰지 말 것. 관람권·참가비 숫자 금지.

## 그대로 써도 되는 사실 (영어)
1. Individual start times are linked ~3 days before the event (about now). Start time changes are not permitted.
2. Flex refund windows are closed. Tickets bought within 6 weeks of the event are non-refundable. Do not mention refunds.
3. Lite Flex / Flex: 1 name change per ticket until 07:59 AM Seoul time the day before your race. Substitute must be the same gender. No Flex = no name change. No transfers to another event.
   - Friday racers: until Thu Nov 12 07:59. Saturday: Fri Nov 13 07:59. Sunday: Sat Nov 14 07:59.
4. Bring ID. Checking in on behalf of others is not allowed.
5. Early registration (Friday racers only): Thu Nov 12, 11:00–19:00, EPIC SEOUL 5F, The Hyundai Seoul. No spectator check-in.
6. Race-day registration at KINTEX opens 07:30 for the first division, closes 20:00 each day.
7. Wristband = venue access only on your race day. Enter early via Spectators check-in with your athlete ticket QR (race day only). Other days need a spectator ticket.
8. Course tip: "Go IN the SECOND time you see the 'IN'."
9. Parking ₩3,720/hour · ₩19,000 all-day (5+ hours → all-day).
10. Sportograf photos ~48 hours after your race (selfie search).
